$comment: Boundry governance contract. Normative text: SPEC.md in this directory. Language-independent; each application maps its own operations onto these effects and enforces the rules in its own trust boundary. Conformance: vectors.json. 1.1.0: agents may withdraw their own proposals (the role table now matches §3.6); when several rules refuse, any of their codes conforms (vectors list them in expect.codes). 1.2.0: withdrawal and rejection end at claim; abandonment (person-only, reconcile first); retry requires reconciliation.

principalTypes.person: A human, identified by the application's authentication. The only type that approves, rejects or administers.
principalTypes.agent: Software acting for someone (e.g. over MCP). Inspects and proposes. Never approves, administers or executes.
principalTypes.component: A declared part of an application that performs approved work with its own credential. Never proposes or approves.

effects.observe: Read external authorities and record a projection. Never mutates an external system.
effects.propose: Create a proposal. Changes nothing outside the proposal record.
effects.approve.protected: Additionally required to approve in a protected scope.
effects.withdraw: Withdraw one's own proposal, or (with approve) reject someone else's, before the irreversible step.
effects.trigger: Ask the executing component to carry out an approved proposal. Grants no authority over what runs.
effects.execute: Perform the approved external mutation, conditionally, and record evidence.
effects.sign: Read a proposal and its audit trail to issue an authorization derived from it.
effects.abandon: Stop pursuing a claimed execution after reconciling with every authority (§7a). Person-only; never withdrawal, never rollback.

defaultPolicy.$comment: A scope with no recorded policy is treated as protected with one approval: unknown is never treated as safe.

authentication.$comment: asserted = a name the caller typed. It never satisfies a production approval.
